token.description: One-use host authority for this candidate and request deadline.

hash.description: The stored tool version to activate.

expectedDataRevision.description: The data revision the activation was planned against (MIG-06).

startChecked.description: The app's staging ran the start check (smoke) on this candidate and it passed: the app's report, recorded as such (APP-05).

behaviorChecked.description: The app's staging also ran the behavior check of the profile the server named for this candidate, and it passed: the app's report, recorded as such with that profile (VER-08).

description: What the host page sends to activate a tool version that passed its checks.
